title: JOVRA Studio PTS table (jovra.pts-table/1)
description: The table kept beside one render proxy: the original's decoded presentation-timestamp index (run-length encoded, rational timescale), the render proxy's constant-frame-rate clock (track timescale lcm(fps num, 1000), zero start), its geometry (rotation baked exactly once, no display rotation left) and colour (SDR; an HDR original declares its tone-map method), and the run-length map from every proxy frame to the original frame it shows. Its canonical SHA-256 is what a SourceManifest render proxy binds as ptsTableSha256. The reference (spec/reference/studio/normalization.py) rebuilds the map from the index with the one half-up rule and requires identical runs.

timescale.description: The original video track's media timescale; every PTS below is an integer on it.

pts.description: The decoded presentation timestamps in presentation order, run-length encoded: a run is count frames at value, value + step, value + 2 step, ... (frame indexes are positions in this order, which is what an embedded frame ID encodes). Canonical greedy form; see the module page.

endPts.description: The end of the last frame (its PTS plus its duration), on the original timescale.

timescale.description: Track timescale, exactly lcm(fps.num, 1000): 3000 for 24, 30, 60 and 120 fps, 30000 for 30000/1001, 1000 for 25.

frameDurationTicks.description: timescale * fps.den / fps.num, an integer by construction; proxy frame k has PTS k * frameDurationTicks.

rotationAppliedDegrees.description: The rotation baked into the pixels, exactly the original's rotationDegrees.

displayRotationDegrees.description: Rotation left in the container (track matrix or side data). Always 0: a kept rotation would be applied a second time by players.

toneMap.description: Required exactly when the original is HDR; null for an SDR original.

upconverted.description: True exactly when the proxy rate is above the original's nominal rate (frames are duplicated; the angle is labelled with its source rate).

runs.description: Proxy frame -> original frame, run-length encoded in canonical greedy form: proxy frames proxyFrame .. proxyFrame + count - 1 show original frames originalFrame + j * originalStep (step 0 holds a frame). originalPts is the PTS of originalFrame.

method.description: ffmpeg zscale+tonemap, ffmpeg libplacebo, Apple VideoToolbox/AVFoundation, or Media3 Transformer's OpenGL tone map (multicam-sync research 5.4).

params.description: The method's parameters as one canonical string, so every angle of a film can be checked for the same method and parameters.
